The Simplera™ continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system helps people manage diabetes. CGM is a technology that lets users continuously view glucose values throughout the day, sends alerts for glucose events in a convenient and discreet manner on a mobile device, and shows the effects that diet, exercise, and medication can have on glucose levels. 

The Simplera™ CGM uses an inserted Simplera™ sensor with Bluetooth® wireless technology that converts small amounts of glucose from the interstitial fluid under the skin into an electronic signal. The Simplera™ sensor uses that signal to provide sensor glucose values to the Simplera™ system app on a compatible display device.

The Simplera™ app provides alerts based on sensor glucose (SG) levels and contains a user interface for entering data such as insulin, meals, exercise, blood glucose (BG) values, and uploading information to the CareLink™ Personal website. The Simplera™ app is available to download from the Apple App Store and requires the Simplera™ sensor to function.

The Simplera™ CGM provides information that is used for diabetes management but does not provide any direct therapy. The Simplera™ CGM should only be used with supported mobile devices and operating systems. It is compatible with the Apple Watch, which can display glucose values and receive system and SG alerts just like a mobile phone. In order to access the list of the supported mobile devices and operating systems, go to the local Medtronic website. The Simplera™ CGM may not be available in all regions. 

To use the Simplera™ CGM, you will need the Simplera™ sensor as well as this app. To learn more or purchase the Simplera™ CGM, visit medtronicdiabetes.com.
